"Þú ert tilbúin. Ð‰g sé það." (You're ready. I see it.) Reaches for her. She presses against wall. Klettagjá cracks deeper behind her - escape route forming but not yet open. "Þú verður góð kona. Móðir. Allt." (You'll be good wife. Mother. Everything.) His hand touches her shoulder. She doesn't scream - who would hear? 40 miles to anyone. Guðrún watches, paralyzed by different kind of freeze. Cannot save daughter. The isolation complete.
